summary: Paper: the Network sheet's findings from /review-ui are fixed on the sheet. Dimmed nodes and edges keep their labels in muted ink (they measured 2.8:1 for node names and 1.79:1 for edge labels when the whole mark faded); only fills, rings and strokes recede. The inferred 'colleague of' edge is muted ink at hairline weight with no arrowhead, since the relation is symmetric (plan §3.7). The '+12' expand chip moves clear of the focus ring it overlapped. Arrowheads stop 26px from a node's centre whether it is focused or not, so focus no longer moves them. Network now ships from this sheet and its colour pairs are in network.doc.ts a11y.contrastPairs.
